== Introduction ==
Ride My Rocket (RMR) is an online [[QuakeWorld]] Free For All ([[FFA]]) tournament. The first tournament received a lot of signups, but unfortunately many of the signed up players did not bother showing up for the matches. Twelve games were played before the final game took place.
